results.description:
Turn Your Photos Into Cross-Stitch Patterns

StitchCraft transforms any photo into a detailed, stitch-ready cross-stitch pattern — right on your iPhone. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned stitcher, StitchCraft gives you the tools to design, customize, and track your projects from start to finish. No account required. No internet needed. Everything happens on your device.

How It Works

Pick a photo from your library and follow a simple four-step wizard. Choose your grid size, select your thread colors, fine-tune brightness and contrast, and preview the final pattern before generating. The result is a color-mapped grid based on real DMC thread codes, ready to stitch.

Prefer to start from scratch? Create a blank canvas and draw your own design using the built-in editor tools.

Real DMC Thread Colors

StitchCraft includes a library of 477 official DMC colors — 441 Stranded Cotton and 36 Light Effects. Every color in your pattern is matched to a real DMC code, so you know exactly which threads to buy. Browse the full color library, search by name or code, and swap colors at any time.

Powerful Pattern Editor

- Switch between color view, symbol view, or combined view
- Draw, erase, and flood-fill individual stitches
- Use the eyedropper tool to pick colors directly from the grid
- Add backstitch lines for outlines and fine details
- Swap all instances of one color with another in a single tap
- Undo recent changes

Track Your Progress

Tap any stitch to mark it as completed. StitchCraft keeps a running count and percentage so you always know how far along you are. Large patterns are split into manageable sections that you can navigate, complete, and review one at a time.

Custom Palettes

Create your own thread palettes from any combination of DMC colors. Use them in the pattern wizard to control exactly which colors are available. Rename, duplicate, or delete palettes as needed.

Export and Share

Generate a print-ready PDF with everything you need:

- Full-color pattern preview and grid stats
- Section-by-section grid pages with symbols and row numbers
- Color legend with DMC codes, stitch counts, and swatch previews
- Shopping list with skein quantities and estimated cost
- Fabric size recommendations for your chosen fabric count

Share the PDF via AirDrop, email, print, or save it to Files.

Shopping List

See exactly how many skeins of each color you need, the total estimated cost, and the recommended fabric dimensions — all calculated automatically based on your pattern size and fabric count.

Built for Stitchers

- Supports fabric counts from 11ct to 28ct
- Shows finished dimensions in both centimeters and inches
- Symbols assigned to every color for monochrome printing
- Patterns up to 200 x 200 stitches
- Projects saved locally and persist across app restarts

Free to Start

Create up to three patterns per day with grids up to 80 stitches wide and 20 colors. Unlock the full experience with StitchCraft Premium for larger patterns, advanced blending modes, image adjustments, custom palettes, PDF export, and shopping lists.

results.description:
Stitch. is a casual puzzle game with embroidery on a numbered grid. The main objective is to fill in the levels' areas with no gaps to complete Hoops. 
Stitch. lets you create beautiful embroidery patterns, by solving levels and Hoops of various difficulties and sizes. It's easy to learn, but hard to master! 
Stitch up all the beautiful landscapes, plants, animals, objects, and more.
 
SIMPLE RULES, CHALLENGING SOLUTIONS
Stitch. offers an expansive range of playable content and thousands of easy to extremely challenging levels. Pick the pattern, size, and category of the Hoop you prefer and move forward through the levels to create an embroidered masterpiece. 
 
REALISTIC EMBROIDERY ENGINE
Like any other form of art, hand embroidery brings you a peaceful, calming, and inspiring experience.
Developed in-house, the realistic embroidery engine helps you enjoy the feel of playing with the real embroidery thread on your device. 
 
REGULAR HOOPS
Stitch. features over 800 regular Hoops in multiple sizes and categories. 
Up to a long embroidery adventure? Pick a beautiful landscape hoop in XXL size. 
Looking for something quick and fun to help you unwind? - Stitch up a cute teddy bear or a colorful plant!
 Every Hoop you complete can then be shared.
 
WEEKLY HOOPS
Weekly Hoops are limited edition content that becomes available to play every week.
Discover a new Weekly Hoop every 7 days and get it solved until it is gone!
Weekly Hoops' themes and patterns reflect famous international events and unlock fun, educational facts about each of them.
 
Did you know World Embroidery Day is celebrated on July 30?
 
FREE STITCH MODE
After completion, each Hoop can be alternatively played in Free Stitch mode. Pick your favorite pattern and color it just the way you like!
Free Stitch mode becomes available after the tutorial steps completion.
 
CHALLENGES
Follow and complete all the various and fun challenges to collect points, upgrade in tiers and obtain achievements.
 
ACCESSIBILITY
Stitch. offers a range of accessibility features that are imported from your iOS/iPadOS settings and can be managed through the main menu of the game:
1. The “Number Outlines” feature creates sharper and more contrasted outlines for the numbers on the grid to help color blindness or the visually impaired.
2. The “Reduce Motion” feature disables all sudden movements and animations.
3. The “Big Numbers” feature increases the size of the numbers of the grid for better visibility. 
 
UNIVERSAL & FAMILY FRIENDLY
Stitch. is a family-friendly game, suitable for players of all ages and genders.
(IGRS rating: 3+)
